83dbf3ac01f347dcb82ecea7b4e3f259049662d8.summary: Unit 42 (Palo Alto Networks) says the North Korean state-sponsored group Jumpy Pisces (also Andariel, Onyx Sleet) likely collaborated with the Play ransomware group (Fiddling Scorpius) in a 2024 intrusion. Access began in May 2024 through a compromised user account, using Sliver and DTrack, and Play ransomware was deployed in early September 2024. Unit 42 assesses with moderate confidence that the group acted as an affiliate or an initial access broker, and says this remains unclear. Tools included Mimikatz and PsExec.

hedges: Collaboration with Play ransomware is assessed with moderate confidence; the report says a faction of the group may be involved.
It remains unclear whether the group became a Play affiliate or acted as an initial access broker.
Play says it does not run a RaaS ecosystem; the report notes some suggest it has moved to RaaS.
Initial access via the compromised account is stated with high confidence.
Some suspicious files did not successfully execute or were not recoverable at the time of investigation.
